comments.body:
@pcbeingused333 Thanks for suggesting a fix. As you pointed, this is breaking and can't be merged right now.
However, there is a non-breaking solution for this:
- Add a new property `long? SizeInBytes` and keep `Size`
- Map existing `Size` to the new `long?` property
- Add `JsonIgnore` and `Obsolete` on `Size`
- On `Size`, return null when it exceeds max value, without throwing

On a side note, I notice your PR exposes a public API change, but PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt isn't modified for storage.
Our quality gate will report this as a build error.

Thanks, switched to the non-breaking approach: new `long? SizeInBytes`, `Size` kept as obsolete/JsonIgnore returning null above int.MaxValue, and PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt updated.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
